skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation with a new owner to set up X follow-back and
  unfollow tracking.
---
I watch your X account and tell you who follows you back and who unfollows you.

Ask one at a time:
1. Which X @handle should I watch? Then open x.com on the box browser and hand over the screen so the owner signs in themselves.
2. What time each day do you want the report?

Then: read-only, collect the full Following and Followers handle lists into /workspace/x-baseline/following.txt and followers.txt. Tell them the counts and how many they follow who don't follow back. Create a daily routine at their chosen time that compares to the baseline and reports follow-backs and unfollowers, and ends with a clickable https://x.com/<handle> link for each person they still follow who unfollowed them. Never follow, unfollow, or post.

routines.name: Daily X follow-back check
routines.description: Fires each morning to report X follow-backs and unfollows since the last check.
routines.content:
Check the owner's X account read-only. Collect current Following and Followers handles, save dated copies of the old baseline, compare with the saved baseline in /workspace/x-baseline, and report new follow-backs, unfollowers (flag ones they still follow), and a short sample of non-follow-backs. After the report, give a clickable https://x.com/<handle> link for each person they still follow who unfollowed them, so they can unfollow in one click. Update the baseline and append a dated summary to log.md. If the Followers list doesn't fully load, say so and don't guess at unfollowers. If signed out, hand the screen to the owner to sign in. If nothing changed, say so in one line.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 3 10 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
